scope: Provider-specific route normalization and value-free form recognition for a review-first Greenhouse application adapter.
implemented: Normalize HTTPS job routes on boards.greenhouse.io and job-boards.greenhouse.io to one canonical boards.greenhouse.io URL.
Reject non-Greenhouse providers, unsupported hosts, credentials, non-default ports, malformed paths and requisitions, and conflicting supplied tenant or requisition values.
Use the existing bounded form analyzer for DOM metadata without returning current field values.
Require human review for unknown, malformed, ambiguous or sensitive form analysis.

Declare the current capability boundary: route normalization, form metadata extraction and uncertainty review are supported; document upload, live form interaction and submission are not supported by this adapter slice.

The selected Python interpreter has no SQLAlchemy package; test import failed before integration execution.

not_run: Connected synthetic application worker flow, document uploads, manual authentication resume, dry-run behavior, mock confirmation, durable audit readback and restart recovery.
GitHub-hosted tests and reviews, disabled by project policy.
limitations: The provider adapter is not mounted into shared API/UI/worker composition; that integration is outside this lane's allowed paths and requires serial integrator work.
Greenhouse-specific document upload, live form interaction, persistence and confirmation are not implemented by this slice.
